summary: Enhance your skills with our Risk Assessment and Adaptation Planning for Climate Change training. Prepare for future challenges and drive effective solutions.
lede: Urban climate resilience training helps professionals assess climate risks to city systems and plan practical responses. It is for people who plan, finance, design, deliver or manage urban systems and need to protect services and assets from climate shocks. Participants learn to map vulnerabilities, interpret climate data, trace cascading service failures, and prioritize and justify resilience interventions through planning, budgeting and investment decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, finance, design, deliver, or manage urban systems and must integrate climate resilience into their decisions.
audience: Urban planners and development control teams
Infrastructure, transport, and public works professionals
Climate change focal persons and sustainability officers
Disaster risk management and emergency response teams
Private sector developers, insurers, financiers, and asset
NGO and donor-funded urban program leads
modules: Foundations of Urban Resilience to Climate Change
Understanding Urban Climate Risks and Vulnerability Hotspots
Systems Thinking and Cascading Failures in Cities
Resilient Urban Planning and Land Use Management
Resilience Investment Planning and Project Justification
Urban Disaster Risk Management and Preparedness
Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning for Resilience
prerequisites: Participants should have basic knowledge of urban planning or climate change adaptation principles. Prior experience in managing urban systems is beneficial but not mandatory.
